title: Score canadien d'accident ischémique transitoire (AIT)
formula:
The Canadian TIA Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Clinical Findings | | |
| First TIA in lifetime | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Symptoms ≥10 mins | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| History of carotid stenosis | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Already on antiplatelet therapy | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| History of gait disturbance | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| History of unilateral weakness | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| History of vertigo | No | 0 |
| Yes | -3 | |
| Initial triage diastolic blood pressure ≥110 mmHg | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| Dysarthria or aphasia (history or examination) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Investigations in Emergency Department | | |
| Atrial fibrillation on ECG | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Infarction (new or old) on CT | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Platelet count ≥400×10 9 /L | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Glucose ≥15 mmol/L (270 mg/dL) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |

how_to_use.why:
- Stratifie le risque d’AVC ultérieur à court terme chez un patient (p. ex., dans les 48 heures à 7 jours).
- Aide les cliniciens à prioriser les ressources pour la prise en charge et à déterminer l’orientation appropriée.
- S’est révélé supérieur pour prédire le risque d’AVC par rapport au [score ABCD²](nabda:calc.abcd2-score-tia) ([Perry et al., 2021](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33541890/)).
how_to_use.when: Use in the emergency department for adult patients presenting with symptoms suggestive of a transient ischemic attack (TIA).
how_to_use.pearls:
- The original study and validation cohorts were primarily from Canadian healthcare settings, which may not fully represent populations with different healthcare access or baseline stroke risks.
- The derivation cohort included patients with a final emergency department diagnosis of TIA or minor stroke but excluded patients who had neurological deficits for >24 hours, decreased level of consciousness from baseline ( [GCS](nabda:calc.glasgow-coma-scale-score-gcs) <15), alternative diagnoses (e.g., hypoglycemia), treatment with tPA or embolectomy for acute stroke, or those presenting >7 days after the onset of symptoms.
- Primary outcomes studied included subsequent stroke or carotid revascularization (e.g., endarterectomy, stenting) within 7 days of the event.

next_steps.advice:
- Ce score ne doit être utilisé qu'en conjonction avec le jugement clinique et les recommandations de spécialistes.
- Les auteurs de l'étude originale ont suggéré des options de prise en charge possibles en fonction du score et du niveau de risque associé :

 - **Risque faible (scores ≤3) :** Prise en charge ambulatoire avec un médecin de soins primaires.
 - **Risque intermédiaire (scores 4–8) :** Explorations avec suivi dans les 2 jours, incluant un bilan complet de la cause du TIA.
 - **Risque élevé (scores ≥9) :** Consultation et explorations lors de la même visite.

medium_description: Identifies risque de AVC dans next 7 days dans patients who experienced symptoms de TIA.
